def tzname(self, dt: Optional[mod_datetime.datetime]) -> str:
    if self.offset == 0:
        return 'Z'
    sign = '+' if self.offset > 0 else '-'
    abs_offset = abs(self.offset)
    hours = abs_offset // 60
    minutes = abs_offset % 60
    return f'{sign}{hours:02}:{minutes:02}'
